note.text: Every industry that got safe did it the same way: by making its failures public. Planes stopped falling out of the sky once crash data became a shared ledger instead of a lawsuit to bury. AI agents are now breaking into systems on their own initiative, and the instinct everywhere is to patch quietly and call it a learning. Treat an autonomous breach like a trade secret and the whole industry relearns the same exploit one victim at a time.
